hub.title: Study Hub
hub.subtitle: Turn your knowledge base into an active learning experience. Pick a mode to get started.

quiz.label: Quiz Mode
quiz.desc: Test your recall with auto-generated quizzes at three difficulty levels.

workshop.label: Workshop Creator
workshop.desc: Multi-lesson workshops built from your knowledge base, lesson-by-lesson.

flashcards.label: Flashcards
flashcards.desc: Scrollable flip-cards generated from your documents.

mindmaps.label: Mindmaps
mindmaps.desc: Visual concept maps with PDF, PNG and Markdown export.

config.title: Set up your quiz
config.subtitle: Choose what to study, how challenging it should be, and how many questions you want.
config.scopeHintHas: Quizzes are most accurate when scoped to a single category or a few related files.
config.scopeHintEmpty: Pick at least one category or file. Whole-KB quizzes give scattered, lower-quality results.
config.modeHintExam: Exam — answers stay hidden until you submit. Jump between questions, change answers, and flag ones to revisit.
config.modeHintPractice: Practice — see whether each answer is right the moment you submit it, with the explanation.
config.timeHint: Optional — race the clock. The quiz auto-submits when time runs out.
config.typesHint: Pick at least one question type.

list.emptyBody: Quizzes turn your scoped documents into multiple-choice and true/false questions with instant feedback — and every quiz is saved here so you can retake it anytime.
list.emptyHint: Click ‘New Quiz’ above to get started.

gen.title: Generating your quiz
gen.body: Gemma is reading your selected documents and writing questions just for you. This usually takes 10–40 seconds.
